body:
Argues with the visitors about service, moral responsibility and the Rahu.

Recorded role and choices

In February 2026, Acalan questions Flame and condemns service to devils and Nuru. These are Acalan’s religious and moral judgments, not objective Codex definitions of the god or all Rahu people. His role in the scene is a named participant in a dispute, offering an account of responsibility and repentance without establishing a universal doctrine or an outcome for Camilla.
